note: Fixed heuristic situations read from on-screen signals; not optimal play. Exclude any pair with ceilingHits > 0 from balance claims.

probes.situation: Bushes stripped: 20 or fewer bushes, under 20% full (they wither after ten bare days)
probes.mistimedSituation: Rabbit boom with many foxes: 250+ rabbits and 20+ foxes
Meadow already has 40 or more bushes (the limit is 48)
Rabbit boom with many foxes: 250+ rabbits and 20+ foxes
Fox-heavy meadow: 20+ foxes and fewer than 8 rabbits per fox

probes.situation: Overhunting: 10+ foxes, fewer than 5 rabbits per fox, rabbits down 15% in 10 days

probes.mistimedSituation: Overhunting: fed foxes breed while rabbits keep falling

probes.situation: Rabbit boom on bare bushes: 300+ rabbits, bushes under 20% full (the intended use; no benefit found)
Fox-heavy meadow before the crash: 20+ foxes and fewer than 8 rabbits per fox
